items.reason: The oil control mattifying gel you asked for suits oily skin and helps reduce shine through the day while doubling as a light moisturizer.
A gentle, non-stripping cleanser keeps the surface fresh without drying skin out and prompting extra shine.
A lightweight mineral SPF fluid protects skin each morning and layers neatly over the gel.

response.routine_note: Morning: cleanse, apply the mattifying gel, then finish with the SPF; at night, cleanse and use the gel again. Start with this simple routine for a few weeks before considering anything else.
